test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: President Droupadi Murmu was recently conferred with the highest civilian award of which of the following countries during her 2024 state visit?

options.text: Suriname - Grand Order of the Yellow Star
Timor-Leste - Grand Collar of the Order
Mauritius - Order of the Star and Key

solution:
The correct answer is __**Timor-Leste - Grand Collar of the Order**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **President Droupadi Murmu** was recently conferred with the **Grand Collar of the Order of Timor-Leste**, the highest civilian honor of the country, during her **2024 state visit to Timor-Leste**.
 
• The **Grand Collar of the Order** is awarded to distinguished individuals for their exceptional contributions to fostering international relations and strengthening diplomatic ties with Timor-Leste.
 
• This recognition marks a significant milestone in the diplomatic relations between **India and Timor-Leste**,
